facts.fact_text: On 18 April 2000 the applicant organisation informed the Plovdiv Municipality of its intention to hold a public rally on 19 April 2000 in front of the municipality.
The aim of the public rally planned for 19 April 2000 was to protest against the Plovdiv Municipality's actions of uprooting and eradicating the river "Maritza"'s plant life.

The aim of the public rally planned for 19 April 2000 included a demand that the disorderly uprooting and eradication of the river "Maritza"'s plant life be stopped because it was destroying important alluvial trees and the habitat of rare, endangered birds.
In a letter dated 19 April 2000 the Plovdiv Municipality informed the applicant organisation that it would not permit the planned public rally to go ahead.
The applicant organisation did not hold a rally on 19 April 2000.
